--- Page 1 (Beckerman_11a) --- Dear Folks & Ruth: Just a few lines to acknowledge receipt of your most cheerful letter of 17 Jan. When I wrote to you on Sunday I said "no mail" but on Mon. your letter arrived together with a copy of the Bulletin. (A little by the way I have already received but will make good use of by sending to one of the boys.) The article by Dave Priddy that you sent to me some time ago was forwarded to me. I sent it to Max Handler who in turn has forwarded it to one of the Knut twins. So you see these things do get around. Am enclosing by way of interest two copies of the weekly newspaper that we put out in our Office. This name won't mean anything to you, but you can realize that we are a big and playful gang. Besides --- Page 2 (Beckerman_11b) --- 2 it's a good addition to the memo folder! Thanks for the inter- esting stories about the [illegible] and [illegible] thing else. I kind of forget about those things. It should be three years of army life for me on Feb. 22. Uncle, it hasn't been too bad. About records - couldn't you pack them within the P.O. required size. Some of the fellows have gotten them. How about sending me a two just as an experiment! Your talk of snow sounds beautiful. all for tonight Love Jack.
